q: What is the primary difference between brand marketing and performance marketing?
options: Brand marketing is always free, while performance marketing is paid
Performance marketing pays for specific, measurable results; brand marketing focuses on general awareness
Brand marketing only runs on television
There is no difference between the two
explain: Performance marketing is focused on measurable returns like clicks, leads, and sales where cost per result is strictly tracked.

q: If you spend ₹3,000 on an ad campaign and receive 60 customer inquiries, what is your Cost Per Lead (CPL)?
Which Meta tool is the central command center for managing ad accounts, pixels, and team access?
explain: Meta Business Portfolio (formerly Business Manager) connects and manages all business assets securely in one place.

q: Where in the 3-level Meta ad structure do you choose your audience targeting and budget?
explain: Campaign defines the Objective. Ad Set defines Audience, Placements, Schedule & Budget. Ad defines Creative & Copy.

q: A bakery wants customers to book custom wedding cakes. Which campaign objective should they select?
explain: Leads objective optimizes for people who are likely to submit contact details or message to book an order.

q: What is the formula to calculate Click-Through Rate (CTR)?
explain: CTR = (Clicks ÷ Impressions) × 100. It measures the percentage of viewers who clicked after seeing the ad.

q: Your ad was shown 10,000 times to 5,000 distinct individuals. What is the frequency?
What risk arises if your target audience size is too narrow (e.g. under 30,000 people)?
options: The ad will be disapproved by Meta
Audience fatigue happens quickly and CPM shoots up
Meta will spend double your daily budget
explain: A tiny audience gets exhausted fast, frequency spikes, and the auction charges a high CPM penalty.

q: As a rule of thumb, what is a recommended minimum starting daily budget for a local lead generation campaign?
options: At least 3x to 5x your target CPL (e.g. ₹300-₹500/day)
explain: Starting with 3x-5x your target CPL gives the algorithm enough budget to generate a few conversions per day.

q: Within how many seconds must a video ad grab a mobile viewer's attention to stop them from scrolling?
explain: Mobile users scroll rapidly; if the hook doesn't land in the first 3 seconds, viewers will swipe away.

q: How does an ad with high user engagement and quality beat a competitor with a higher cash bid?
options: Total Auction Value = Bid × Estimated Action Rate + Ad Quality
Meta always favors the newest account
It doesn't; only the highest rupee bid wins
explain: Meta wants a great user experience. High quality and high predicted action rate can beat a raw high bid.

q: You launched a new campaign 12 hours ago. Leads are zero so far. What is the best immediate move?
options: Immediately delete the campaign and restart
Double the budget to force delivery
Verify tracking works, then avoid making edits and let it run for 48-72 hours
Change the video creative every 2 hours
explain: Never panic on day 1. Constantly editing resets the learning phase. Verify tracking and allow 48-72 hours for initial delivery.

q: Which of the following is an example of a Custom Audience?
options: All people in Mumbai interested in cricket
People who visited your website's pricing page in the last 30 days
explain: Custom audiences are built from people who already had a relationship or touchpoint with your business.

q: Which Lookalike audience percentage represents people closest and most similar to your seed list?
explain: 1% Lookalike includes the top 1% of people in the target country who most closely resemble your customer seed list.

q: What happens if a boutique runs a 'Sales' objective campaign without the Meta Pixel installed?
options: Meta automatically guesses the sales from bank accounts
The campaign records zero conversions and cannot optimize for buyers
The ad will run completely free of cost
explain: Without the Pixel, Meta has no feedback loop on who bought, making conversion optimization impossible.

q: What is the primary risk of setting a Cost Cap that is unrealistically low (e.g. ₹10 CPL when market average is ₹80)?
options: Meta will ban your ad account
The campaign will fail to spend budget and won't deliver impressions
Your ad will show only on desktop
explain: If your Cost Cap is below auction prices, Meta won't win any bids, and your budget will sit unspent.

q: Approximately how many conversion events per ad set in a 7-day period are required to exit the Learning Phase?
explain: Meta's machine learning model generally requires about 50 optimization events per ad set within a 7-day window.

q: When vertically scaling a winning ad set's daily budget, what is the recommended maximum increase per 48 hours?
explain: Increasing budget by more than 20% shocks the auction bidding algorithm and usually resets the learning phase.
